review_candidates.title: Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Monitoring & incident response Monitor SMS traffic, delivery rates, latency, and error codes in real time across supplier routes and client binds. Maintain runbooks, shift handover notes and escalation paths so the 24×7 rota runs consistently. Requirements Must have 2–5 years in NOC, SMS operations, routing or technical support at an SMS / CPaaS / telecom company.
eligibility_evidence: The company was founded within a software group with 15+ years of enterprise delivery, and today has a team of 41 across 14 nationalities, with offices in Dubai (commercial HQ and carrier relations desk), Riyadh (enterprise and regulatory), and Cairo (engineering and the 24×7 NOC).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Must have 2–5 years in NOC, SMS operations, routing or technical support at an SMS / CPaaS / telecom company. Hands-on with SMPP, SMSC / SMS gateway platforms and routing configuration.
